amendments.change: Increase calibration and held-out nulls to 4096 each, before generation; keep 2048 injections.
Use two ZTF GTLS workers with public CuPy cache release; supersede and recompute all initial four-worker ZTF calibration results. No held-out cases had yet been generated or inspected.
Add the secondary BLS control without altering the primary comparisons; before inspecting held-out outcomes.

conditioning: At least five in-transit observations and two observed events; known unit band baselines; achromatic transits; solar density and circular orbits.
detection: Score above independently calibrated threshold AND primary-period total drift at most half the injected transit duration over the full cadence baseline.

acceptance.difference_bounds: Paired discordant-cell Clopper-Pearson bounds, alpha/2 per cell; subtract cell bounds.
acceptance.primary_population: Equally weighted mixture of the four injected SNR strata.

selection: Fastest predeclared v1 setting passing all criteria per cadence. If none passes, original settings remain an explicitly unqualified timing comparison.
secondary: Original/intermediate versus fine and complete TLS versus BLS controls: diagnostic, nominal bounds, outside primary claims.

timing.source: Earlier heldout archives, used as tuning/timing data only in this follow-up.
timing.scheduling: Sequential isolated configuration processes, randomized order, synchronized warmed APIs.
timing.single_gtls: One worker; contextual latency when recovery calibration uses a concurrent batch policy.
timing.boundary: Prepared host observations and explicit grid to host periodograms and native candidates; includes transfers and API postprocessing.
